prompt: The query in the editor has one mistake. Fix it so that it answers this question: for each product whose sku is in lower case, what is its model number? This table may hold errors. Some skus are in lower case. Each product_name ends with a three-digit model number, such as 878 in 'Nordvue Neo 878'. Return two columns, in this order: product_id and model_number, the last three characters of product_name, as text. Return one row for each product whose sku starts with 'vm' in lower case. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, count the start position of the last three characters by hand.
In a name of 15 characters the last three are characters 13, 14 and 15, so the start is the length minus 2, not minus 3.
starter_sql:
SELECT product_id, substring(product_name, length(product_name) - 3, 3) AS model_number
FROM products
WHERE sku LIKE 'vm%'
why_this_works: Positions count from 1, so the last three characters start at the length minus 2.
